name: stavya-ris
description: Radiology management system for Stavya Spine Hospital: OPD/IPD/OT coordination, orders, worklist, reporting, critical findings, audit. No PACS.

scripts.start: node -e "const M=+process.versions.node.split('.')[0]; if(M<22){console.error('Need Node >=22.5 for node:sqlite. Run: ./start.sh  (brew install node@24)'); process.exit(1)}" && node server/index.js
